-	end

 			return true
@@ -115,22 +110,3 @@
 	end

-
-# A fresh value may be passed to a mutable parameter, but mutation syntax
-# requires a binding. Follow checked indexed receivers without token guessing.
-def checked_hash_binding_target(state: Gate4Compiler, origin: Integer): Boolean
-	mut root := origin
-	mut depth := 0
-	while depth < state.token_count[0]
-		parent := checked_hash_plan(state, root)
-		if parent.kind == 1
-			return false
-		end
-		if parent.kind != 2
-			return true
-		end
-		root = parent.receiver_origin
-		depth += 1
-	end
-	return false
-end

function l $g4_hash_code(l %key, l %string) {
@start
 jnz %string, @string, @integer
@integer
 %shift1 =l shr %key, 30
 %xor1 =l xor %key, %shift1
 %mix1 =l mul %xor1, 13787848793156543929
 %shift2 =l shr %mix1, 27
 %xor2 =l xor %mix1, %shift2
 %mix2 =l mul %xor2, 10723151780598845931
 %shift3 =l shr %mix2, 31
 %result =l xor %mix2, %shift3
 ret %result
@string
 %length_slot =l add %key, 8
 %length =l loadl %length_slot
 %data =l add %key, 16
 jmp @loop
@loop
 %index =l phi @string 0, @byte %next
 %hash =l phi @string 14695981039346656037, @byte %next_hash
 %done =w ceql %index, %length
 jnz %done, @finish, @byte
@byte
 %address =l add %data, %index
 %byte =w loadub %address

 jmp @loop
@finish

}

function l $g4_hash_slot(l %table, l %key) {
@start
 %capacity_slot =l add %table, 16
 %capacity =l loadl %capacity_slot
 %empty =w ceql %capacity, 0
 jnz %empty, @empty, @prepare
@empty
 ret -1
@prepare
 %mask =l sub %capacity, 1
 %keys_slot =l add %table, 24
 %keys =l loadl %keys_slot
 %data_slot =l add %keys, 24
 %data =l loadl %data_slot
 %flags_slot =l add %table, 40
 %flags =l loadl %flags_slot
 %string =l and %flags, 1
 %hash =l call $g4_hash_code(l %key, l %string)
 %initial =l and %hash, %mask
 jmp @probe
@probe
 %index =l phi @prepare %initial, @advance %next
 %first =l phi @prepare -1, @advance %next_first
 %scaled =l mul %index, 8
 %address =l add %data, %scaled
 %stored =l loadl %address
 %vacant =w ceql %stored, 0
 jnz %vacant, @vacant, @occupied
@occupied
 %integer_tomb =w ceql %stored, -1
 %string_tomb_match =w ceql %stored, $g4_hash_tombstone
 %is_string =w cnel %string, 0
 %string_tomb =w and %is_string, %string_tomb_match
 %tomb =w or %integer_tomb, %string_tomb
 jnz %tomb, @deleted, @compare
@deleted
 %unset =w csltl %first, 0
 jnz %unset, @remember, @retain
@remember
 jmp @advance
@retain
 jmp @advance
@compare
 %identity =w ceql %stored, %key
 jnz %identity, @found, @content
@content
 jnz %string, @strings, @different
@strings
 %same =l call $g4_string_equal(l %stored, l %key)
 jnz %same, @found, @different
@different
 jmp @advance
@advance
 %next_first =l phi @remember %index, @retain %first, @different %first
 %increment =l add %index, 1
 %next =l and %increment, %mask
 jmp @probe
@found
 ret %index
@vacant
 %has_deleted =w cslel 0, %first
 jnz %has_deleted, @use_deleted, @use_vacant
@use_deleted
 %deleted_result =l sub -1, %first
 ret %deleted_result
@use_vacant
 %vacant_result =l sub -1, %index
 ret %vacant_result
}
")

function $g4_hash_put(l %table, l %key, l %value) {
@start
 %position =l call $g4_hash_slot(l %table, l %key)

 jnz %found, @replace, @capacity
@replace

 ret
@capacity

 %capacity =l loadl %capacity_slot
 %count_slot =l add %table, 8
 %count =l loadl %count_slot
 %tombs_slot =l add %table, 48
 %tombs =l loadl %tombs_slot

 %next_occupied =l add %occupied, 1
 %scaled =l mul %next_occupied, 4
 %limit =l mul %capacity, 3
 %full =w csgtl %scaled, %limit
 jnz %full, @resize, @insert
@resize
 %zero =w ceql %capacity, 0
 jnz %zero, @initial, @choose
@initial
 jmp @rebuild
@choose
 %live_next =l add %count, 1
 %live_scaled =l mul %live_next, 4
 %need_grow =w csgtl %live_scaled, %limit
 jnz %need_grow, @grow, @compact
@grow
 %too_large =w cslel 1125899906842624, %capacity
 jnz %too_large, @fail, @double
@fail
 call $g4_fail(l $g4_allocation_error, l 26)
 hlt
@double
 %doubled =l mul %capacity, 2
 jmp @rebuild
@compact
 jmp @rebuild
@rebuild
 %new_capacity =l phi @initial 8, @double %doubled, @compact %capacity

 %resized_position =l call $g4_hash_slot(l %table, l %key)
 jmp @insert
@insert

 %index =l sub -1, %available

 %data_slot =l add %keys, 24

@reuse

@store

 storel %value, %value_address

 storel %new_count, %count_slot
 ret
}
